name: @dsh-external/dsh-prompt
description: Editable prompt snippets injected into DSH on three channels: the system prompt, the per-turn runtime context, and a user message at each turn's start. DSH 提示词注入插件：片段可增删改、按通道注入系统提示词 / 运行时上下文 / 每轮用户消息，带设置页与输入框快捷开关。

meta.title: Prompt snippets
meta.description: Manage reusable prompt snippets and choose where each one is injected: the system prompt, the runtime context, or a user message at the start of every turn.
